messages:
Ana Vega: Quick sync request — partners asked for concrete announce windows + marketplace listing slots for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Also want SI integration milestones so joint press + SI onboarding don't clash. Who can own the calendar/slots?
Mike Cho: I can own the calendar. Can you paste partner asks here (dates, embargo needs)?
Jenny Patel: From partner Ops: Nvidia prefers a public H100/H200 announcement late June, with partners asking for a 7-day embargo buffer for co-comms. AMD (MI300) is pushing a mid-July pilot announcement, wants a 2-week developer preview. Habana/Gaudi partners asked for an early-Aug window but flexible.
Prashant Rao: Heads up — runtime/quantized MI300 validations will need ~3w (perf + correctness). If we start June 1, we target June 22 for CI green.
Simon Kline: Our Dedicated pools are tight until July 8 for peak throughput tests. If MI300 perf tests need infra earlier, we might need burst cont to partner lab or cloud.
Nina Morales: Marketing needs at least 1 week for co-announcement assets + one dry-run with partner comms. Ideally we lock dates 3 weeks out.
Ana Vega: Proposed minimal windows based on above: H100/H200 public week of June 22 (embargo June 15), MI300 pilot week of July 13, Gaudi flexible week of Aug 3. Thoughts? :calendar:
Mike Cho: Those look doable, but conflict: H100/H200 week overlaps with an internal infra maintenance on Jun 23-24. Can we shift H100 to Jun 29?
Jenny Patel: Partner legal flagged marketplace listing audits — cloud marketplaces need a 10 business day review after we submit artifacts. That pushes listing availability ~2 weeks after public announce unless we submit early.
Prashant Rao: If we move H100 to Jun 29, we lose 1 week for MI300 prep. Can we parallelize MI300 perf runs on partner lab? I can request instances but need partner sign-off.
Simon Kline: I can request burst capacity on partner lab, but need official PO/approval from Partnerships. Mike, can you note that in calendar invite?
Mike Cho: Yep. I'll add action item in the invite and tag Procurement. Also adding a shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/hw-announces (private link)
Nina Morales: Reminder — co-announcement embargoes: partners often expect a single coordinated embargo time. We should propose a single timestamp per region. Also checklist: kill-words, assets, PR contact, executive availability.
Jenny Patel: Also SI integrations: SI teams want SDKs + deployment runbook at least 10 business days pre-announce. That means final SDK freeze by: H100 -> Jun 15 (if announce Jun 29), MI300 -> Jun 27 (for Jul 13), Gaudi -> Jul 19 (for Aug 3).
Prashant Rao: Actionable tech tasks: 1) MI300 quantized run: finish model conversion + smoke tests (due Jun 10) 2) End-to-end perf suites (due Jun 22) 3) SI runbook draft (due Jun 27). I'll create PRs and tag reviewers.
Ana Vega: Great. Let's capture assignees: Mike -> calendar/invite + Procurement tag; Simon -> confirm burst infra procurement by EOD; Prashant -> CI/perf timelines; Jenny -> partner legal + marketplace checklist; Nina -> comms timeline + exec availability.
Mike Cho: I'll create the calendar now and include the sheet + proposed windows. Invite: Thu Jun 4 10am PT for a 30-min slot to finalize dates.
Simon Kline: Confirmed I'll update infra constraints by EOD today.
Jenny Patel: I'll start the marketplace package today, ETA for submission June 12 so marketplace review completes by Jun 26.
vendor-bot: Vendor portal updated: MI300_patch_v2 uploaded by partner_ops.
Nina Morales: Quick ask — can we hold a partner dry-run 48h before public? Need to test announcement flow (embargo checks, asset delivery).
Ana Vega: Yes — add dry-run to calendar. Mike, mark it 48h pre-announce for each window.
Mike Cho: Done. Calendar has placeholders + tasks. Link in sheet. :thumbsup:
Prashant Rao: I'll open PRs for CI jobs and tag @Simon + @Jenny for infra/legal checks.
Ana Vega: Thanks everyone. We'll iterate in the Thu Jun 4 slot and lock the final windows.
Mike Cho: Ack.
Jenny Patel: Ack.
Simon Kline: Ack.
Nina Morales: Ack.
Prashant Rao: Ack.
